hero.title: Student Reviews
hero.subtitle: Hear from our learners about their experience with us.
hero.imageAlt: White WagonR training car beside orange traffic cones

ctaText: Have you trained with us? We'd love to hear your feedback!

items.name: Amit Sahoo
items.text: Very good training and supportive instructors. They focus on practical driving and road safety. I got my licence without any hassle. Highly recommended!

items.name: Priyanka Das
items.text: The training is excellent. The instructors are patient and explain everything clearly. I gained full confidence in driving here.

items.name: Subham Jena
items.text: One of the best driving schools in Baleswar. Well-maintained vehicles, practical training and a very professional approach.

items.name: Suman Behera
items.text: I learned driving from scratch and now I can drive confidently. The step-by-step training method is really helpful for beginners.

items.name: Rakesh Patra
items.text: Good training, flexible timings and friendly instructors. The road practice sessions were very useful.

items.name: Ankita Mishra
items.text: A great place to learn driving. They give proper guidance for the driving test and also teach road rules and safety very well.
